snippet.title: Mini Bash Gameplay Reveal Trailer!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Mini Bash now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113730/Mini_Bash/

This is a project I've been working on for about a year now and I'm super excited to get people in and playing soon! I've never made a game before so this has been a huge personal accomplishment for me and I hope you will have as much fun playing as I have making it.

Feel free to join the discord https://discord.com/invite/Ap6zmHSwDe

This isn't a one and done upload here on this channel. Mini Bash has been 100% of my life for a long time now and moving forward I want to include you guys the whole development process. Work on Mini Bash and my next unannounced project will be shared here and I'm already putting together some future uploads. 

Thank you so much for the support through this journey of mine. Dreams coming true and whatever.
